ValidationRule.description: To ensure that all QAC Credit Ledger records should not be modified after it is created.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_QAC_Credits_Ledger_Cannot_be_Modified__c, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Agency_Credit', NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISCHANGED( OwnerId ), ISCHANGED(Account__c) , ISCHANGED(CurrencyIsoCode) , ISCHANGED(Asset__c) , ISCHANGED(Case__c) , ISCHANGED(Reason__c) , ISCHANGED(Transaction_Type__c) , ISCHANGED(User__c) , ISCHANGED(Transaction_Frequency__c) , ISCHANGED(Total_Credit_value__c) , ISCHANGED(Transaction_date__c) , ISCHANGED(Total_Outstanding_credits__c) ), NOT(OR($Profile.Name = "QAC API Integration Profile", $Profile.Name = "Data Administrator" )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot modify Agency Credit Ledger records.
